calculationBasis: Per-serving ingredient-sum estimate: sum(GI × Fineli available carbohydrate per serving)/100. A published GI analogue or category mean may be used with explicit source, match kind and confidence. Ingredients contributing below 1 g available carbohydrate per serving are omitted. This is not a measured mixed-meal response.
massEvidence: docs/nutrition/estimates-2026-10-24.md, Fineli source records and mass assumptions section
excludedIngredientPolicy: To-taste seasoning and lemon amounts use documented standard pilot assumptions and are explicitly marked as estimates. They are omitted only where the estimated available carbohydrate is below 1 g per serving. Unresolved significant ingredients block a recipe total.
